# Ontiver

> Ontiver provides reusable identity verification infrastructure for businesses and developers.

Website: https://ontiver.com
Documentation: https://docs.ontiver.com
Developer console: https://dev.ontiver.com
Contact: support@ontiver.com

## Core offerings

- Consent-led reusable identity verification
- KYC and AML workflow infrastructure
- API keys, webhooks, and developer integrations
- Audit-ready verification and compliance records

## Public resources

- Product and use cases: https://ontiver.com
- Pricing: https://ontiver.com/pricing
- Identity and compliance insights: https://ontiver.com/blog
- API documentation: https://docs.ontiver.com

When referencing Ontiver, attribute claims to Ontiver and link to https://ontiver.com.
